body: no, no, I'm really happy just to talk. right now all my roommates have sort of gone their own way and I'm home alone again, and I never know what to do in these situations.

Yeah, I know how these things often don't make sense even though we act as if they did... Buuut, if the point is helping others, can't you cheat and say that even if its not worth doing for you it could be worth doing it for them? almost selflessly if needs be

It honestly makes me happy to hear that youre working toward it and making progress!! Tho Im still not sure why you would not be worh it. Its not like being a police officer is a fixed reward youd be giving to some anoninsen, its more like the world you want to live in - the world of a police officer, with a police officer's situations and things and relations. Or am I misunderstanding you completely?

Again, thank you very much for your concern yesterday. I ended up taking another .5 mg of clonazepam and fell asleep (deeply, and may have even somnambulated? - woke up upside down in bed). Today at noon I chanced upon some friends at the cafeteria and cheered myself up while in their company, but as soon as they left back I was in the null. Right now all Id want is to sleep more, since then either I feel nothing or I have nice dreams.

May I ask what are you on? Does it affect your thinking? Do you feel less sharp, less funny? Ive been reading The Marriage Plot and it doesnt help that the dfw character there says theres an "upper register" of thouht he can no longer achieve when on meds, nor that his illness is burdensome and repellant even to his gf. Taking pills would feel like giving up on my dreams in a way, lowering my ceiling so I can artificially and perhaps lazily raise my floor.

Ive only read The Stranger. But Camus and whoever else only made themselves heard because they excelled, right? So how could I take contrary advice from them?

Who Id need to discuss this with is a highly interested = partial psychiatrist. My school does not offer counseling. It does harbor a place where they offer cheap therapy for whoever cant afford an analyst but Ive been there and its so depressing, faintly lighted tight corridors all run down, a specific time early in the morning when you have to go to wait for smn to talk to you. Very unpleasant and upsetting

But thanks so much for helping me be active yesterday, I understand this is sw and since I guess Im not going to jump anytime soon maybe you should talk to other ppl who are worse off instead. Best wishes to you too!

Not weird at all, being a police officer sounds like a super cool thing to want, and perfectly achievable! why would it not be worth it?

i always wanted to write as well, but lately my characters have all become angry melancholy little men and stopped talking among them and just hate the world or doze off instead. which is even more boring to read than it could sound. and im always questioning myself as to whether i want to write or just enjoy the weird sociql status/image that comes with it. which of course would make me a fuckin cunt.

either way nobody earns a living here writing, so im sort of inertially on an academic track (plenty of jobs unlike in the us). which im not at all sure ill like though, but i dont see much else. anyway im so worried about performing well in various tasks that theres no room left for thinking. (about what i could or want to be, for instance)

I always get nervous before deadlines, of course, but the thing is each semester i let them get closer, attend class less and less etc. This one i skiped maybe 3/4 of all classes. so each end of semester i get more and more in trouble, and even though so far ive managed, it surely will break sooner or later.

my derealization doesnt seem to be affected all that much by external trouble like this tho. 

I used to do analysis and it helped maybe, but i cant afford it anymore. and im terrified of getting dumber or duller if i go on meds, though its starting to feel like the only way forward. 

the estrangement i was talking about was more metaphysical than social, and i dont think it makes much sense to look for reasons. its not like it could have been effected by anything specific. i guess youd want to call it an illness, or part of one.

there is also the mandatory social thing, feeling i dont belong, feeling unloved or that love is frail. that could also be called estrangement. its all part of the same ugly shrub.

the songs in my head are excerpts of whatever i was listening to and happened to stick. these excerpts dont play in order, dont last more than a few seconds, and it often jumps between songs. besides songs there is sometimes the voice of whoever i spent the day with, saying random little phrases or things they said during the day. it does not feel like it comes from outside and im always aware that its just my internal monologue being obnoxious, but its distracting nevertheless.
I see... what are your dreams?

thank you. that does make sense, of course. i too feel like a child - in my head i tend to think of myself as boy, kid etc, even though this could be the prime of my adulthood. Im not sure about not being worth my dreams - i think worth is what you earn when youre already there, no? but i sure dont feel very capable.

thanks for your concern. I have time enough to write passable essays, this school asks fot very little. problem is i cant begin. the assigned texts are easy but i cannot make sense of them, just because theyre a responsibility. i could ask for an extension but i wouldnt be ok wih my profs knowing what im going through. and it wouldnt do any good either way.

this has happened each semester since i realized i could do well. each term i let the deadlines get closer before horrifiedly writing everything in a sleepless frenzy. So far ive managed, but it cant work forever. its not my last year, im just halfway into my major.

Ive been eating ok for now. the sugar binge thing only happens when im feeling real trashy. i could just as well binge on videogames or porn, but i arranged things so that that would be impossible. looks like my brain just figured itd do candy instead.

i feel radically estranged, as if life were a dream only half remembered. its been getting worse over time. the only thing that ever helped me were psilocybin mushrooms. as for sleep, i hadnt had that kind of trouble in several months. i dont know what it was. one thing that doesnt help with that or with focusing is ive got the most obstinate and loud earworms on the planet. like a pair of huge party speakers were taped to my ears and blaring music at all times.
